reason: The current tied contextual ItemAttention model achieves macro validation HR@10 of 0.4275 versus SASRec's 0.505, with the largest decline in Industrial_and_Scientific (0.385 versus 0.540). Historical embedding-sharing results support retaining tied embeddings, while unsuccessful contextualization motivates the proposed controlled encoder-removal experiment; representation misalignment remains a hypothesis rather than an established cause. Modify model_design to isolate direct item compatibility and training_evaluation to ensure checkpoint reconstruction and prediction match the ablated architecture.

plan.model_design: In ItemAttention.forward, replace positional addition, encoder-input dropout, causal blocks, and history_norm with history = nn.functional.normalize(self.history_embedding(seq), dim=-1), then zero padded positions using the existing mask before computing history_key and pooled values. Remove CausalHistoryBlock, position_embedding, history_blocks, and history_norm so no unused encoder parameters remain, testing whether direct history embeddings better preserve compatibility with candidates from the same shared table. Preserve ItemAttention's constructor signature and forward(self, seq, candidates) and predict(self, seq, candidates), retaining legacy num_blocks and num_heads arguments for interface compatibility while recording num_blocks=0 and never constructing contextual blocks. Keep history_embedding and target_embedding tied, dimension 96, initialization standard deviation 0.05, zero padding row, history_key, target_query, normalized scoring, learned scales, recency_raw, jointly trained item_bias, and the existing self.dropout on pooled history values unchanged. Retain the current padding-safe candidate attention behavior, including finite outputs for entirely padded histories, without adding recurrent layers, auxiliary scorers, or any independently fitted components.
plan.training_evaluation: Update train_category, save_checkpoint, verify_tied_checkpoint, and write_predict_script without changing their signatures so configuration describes the direct-embedding architecture, a new consistent architecture identifier replaces tied_item_attention_v1, and working/predict.py reconstructs it and strictly loads exactly one freshly trained selected checkpoint per category through the existing public predict signature and all four dataset routes. Adapt the synthetic serialization check to verify tied embeddings, unique optimizer parameters, zero padding behavior, finite padded-history scores, absence of encoder parameters, and exact save/load prediction parity while preserving training RNG state. Explicitly keep unchanged preprocessing seed 0 through the supplied splits, training seed 42 and worker seeding, PrefixDataset training-only prefix sampling and negative exclusion, 127 uniform training negatives, cross-entropy, the existing two-term embedding penalty, AdamW settings, gradient clipping, batch size, STEPS, MAXLEN, dropout on pooled values, SASREC_EPOCHS with default 200, time limits, validation cadence, patience, and HR@10 checkpoint selection with NDCG@10 tie-breaking. Preserve DATA_DIR=os.environ['GAGC_DATA_DIR'], trial-local WORKING artifacts, single-GPU execution within the shared search budget, identical validation and prediction processing, and the unchanged independent host evaluator using seed 42, 200 validation users per category, 99 unique negatives, and four-category macro-average HR@10. Evaluate improvement over 0.4275 with 0.45–0.48 only as an experimental target, without accessing hidden tests, other trials or their checkpoints, external datasets or pretrained weights, or introducing ensembles, checkpoint averaging, or separately fitted score combinations.
